options.label: Latest
options.description: Only records produced after the group first joins

fields.name: aggregate
fields.label: Aggregate
fields.help: Optional partition batch aggregation: enabled, by, max_size, flush_interval, dedup, on_overflow, dead_letter_topic. Under entry-seed hosting the batch is admitted to the control plane instead of emitted locally, with an admission key covering the batch's actual offset range; delivery is at-least-once (a batch may be reprocessed once if its offsets fail to commit), so consumers must be idempotent on (topic, partition, offset). flush_interval defaults to 1s in entry-seed mode and 100ms on the legacy emit path. on_overflow decides what happens when a partition reaches its retained bound: "discard" (the default) drops the arriving record and a later commit sweeps past its offset, so it is never redelivered — the loss is counted in xflow_trigger_messages_discarded_total{reason="buffer_overflow"} and logged; "block" loses nothing but halts fetching for the WHOLE assignment until that partition drains, and neither lag gauge can report it, so watch xflow_trigger_consumption_blocked instead; "dead_letter" republishes the record to dead_letter_topic (required with this value) before letting its offset advance, so nothing is lost and nothing stalls while the overflow topic is healthy — a failed republish is retried as backpressure (the partition stops consuming) rather than dropping, counted in xflow_trigger_messages_dead_lettered_total. Set on_overflow explicitly on any topic that cannot afford the default loss.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Aggregation is off unless this is true; every other field is ignored while it is off

fields.name: by
fields.label: By
fields.help: Batch key; only "partition" is supported (the default)

fields.name: max_size
fields.label: Max Size
fields.help: Records per batch; unset or non-positive means 100

fields.name: flush_interval
fields.label: Flush Interval
fields.help: Positive duration; defaults to 1s in entry-seed mode and 100ms otherwise

fields.name: dedup
fields.label: Dedup
fields.help: Deduplication unit; only "message" is supported (the default)

fields.name: on_overflow
fields.label: On Overflow
fields.help: Policy when a partition reaches its retained bound; unset means discard

options.label: Discard
options.description: Drop the arriving record (counted and logged)

options.label: Block
options.description: Halt fetching for the whole assignment until the partition drains

options.label: Dead Letter
options.description: Republish to dead_letter_topic before advancing the offset

fields.name: dead_letter_topic
fields.label: Dead Letter Topic
fields.help: Overflow topic; read only when on_overflow is dead_letter

fields.name: message_schema
fields.label: Message Schema
fields.help: Optional message validation: {required_fields: ["f"], on_invalid: "discard|fail|dead_letter", dead_letter_topic: "t-dlq"}. on_invalid defaults to discard (offset committed, message dropped, drop counted and logged).

fields.name: required_fields
fields.label: Required Fields
fields.help: Top-level keys every message value must carry; an empty list disables validation

fields.name: on_invalid
fields.label: On Invalid
fields.help: Policy for an invalid message; unset means discard

options.label: Discard
options.description: Commit the offset and drop the message (counted and logged)

options.label: Fail
options.description: Withhold the commit so Kafka redelivers; blocks the partition

fields.name: dead_letter_topic
fields.label: Dead Letter Topic
fields.help: Read only when on_invalid is dead_letter

fields.name: tuning
fields.label: Tuning
fields.help: Optional consumer tuning: fetch_min_bytes (1), fetch_max_bytes (10000000), max_wait (10s), dial_timeout (10s), session_timeout (30s), heartbeat_interval (3s), rebalance_timeout (30s). Durations are strings ("45s"). heartbeat_interval must stay below session_timeout or the group rebalances continuously. Offsets always commit synchronously after the side effect; that is not tunable.

fields.name: fetch_min_bytes
fields.label: Fetch Min Bytes
fields.help: Default 1; must not exceed fetch_max_bytes

fields.name: fetch_max_bytes
fields.label: Fetch Max Bytes
fields.help: Default 10000000

fields.name: max_wait
fields.label: Max Wait
fields.help: Default 10s

fields.name: dial_timeout
fields.label: Dial Timeout
fields.help: Default 10s

fields.name: session_timeout
fields.label: Session Timeout
fields.help: Default 30s

fields.name: heartbeat_interval
fields.label: Heartbeat Interval
fields.help: Default 3s; must stay below session_timeout

fields.name: rebalance_timeout
fields.label: Rebalance Timeout
fields.help: Default 30s
